mapper.select: SELECT id, login_id, password, name, role, status FROM admin_users WHERE login_id = #{login_id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_users ( login_id, password, name, role, status ) VALUES ( #{login_id}, #{password}, #{name}, #{role}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(o.total_price) FROM orders o WHERE o.payment_status = 'PAID' AND o.status != 'CANCELLED' ), 0) AS revenue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders) AS order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE is_active = 1) AS customer_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_tariffs ut WHERE ut.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ut.start_date IS NOT NULL AND ut.end_date IS NOT NULL AND NOW() BETWEEN ut.start_date AND ut.end_date ) AS subscription_count

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.ordered_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS sales_date, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_price), 0) AS total FROM orders o WHERE o.payment_status = 'PAID' AND o.status != 'CANCELLED' AND o.ordered_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 6 DAY AND o.ordered_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY DATE(o.ordered_at) ORDER BY DATE(o.ordered_at) ASC

SELECT data.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN dj.status = 'DELIVERED' THEN 'DELIVERED' WHEN dj.status = 'ON_THE_WAY' THEN 'ON_THE_WAY' WHEN dj.status = 'ACCEPTED' THEN 'PREPARING' ELSE o.status END AS status FROM orders o LEFT JOIN delivery_jobs dj ON dj.id = ( SELECT MAX(dj2.id) FROM delivery_jobs dj2 WHERE dj2.order_id = o.id ) WHERE o.ordered_at >= CURDATE() AND o.ordered_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY ) data GROUP BY data.status ORDER BY data.status

SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.order_number AS order_number, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', u.first_name, u.last_name)), ''), NULLIF(u.phone_number, ''), '-' ) AS customer_name, o.total_price AS total_price, CASE WHEN dj.status = 'DELIVERED' THEN 'DELIVERED' WHEN dj.status = 'ON_THE_WAY' THEN 'ON_THE_WAY' WHEN dj.status = 'ACCEPTED' THEN 'PREPARING' ELSE o.status END AS status, o.payment_status AS payment_status, DATE_FORMAT(o.ordered_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS ordered_at FROM orders o LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN delivery_jobs dj ON dj.id = ( SELECT MAX(dj2.id) FROM delivery_jobs dj2 WHERE dj2.order_id = o.id ) ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.stock_quantity AS stock_quantity FROM products p WHERE p.is_active = 1 ORDER BY p.stock_quantity ASC, p.id DESC LIMIT 5
